title: settling-continuity
description: The condition that a settling sequence is continuous: at every limit ordinal its value is the cellwise knowledge-order join (directed colimit) of the values at all preceding settling steps, so no content arises at limits beyond what is approached from below.

sequence.description: the ordinal-indexed predication settling v = (v_tau)_{tau < lambda} being characterized

continuous-at-limits.description: for every limit ordinal mu < lambda and every predicate p, v_mu(p) = join_k { v_sigma(p) : sigma < mu } pointwise in the knowledge-order
